source: Maintained SEED P01: four participants, obols, sigils, curse, rites, raven protection, theft, short board and bounded match. No P01 runtime or historical package exists in the checkout/archive.
authorship: New Codex implementation and design under Martin Melcop Neto's portfolio direction. No recovered code or independent human playtest.
accepted_differences: New eight-venue deterministic C# economy, 20 rounds, any-seat solo and shared-device play for two to four local participants, with optional Planning/Classic rivals. Historical 48 tiles/15 turns/minigames/LAN remain candidate plans, not recovered functionality.
technology: C#/.NET 10 Core/CLI economy 0.1.0 and Godot .NET 4.6.3 native 0.4.0. SDK 10.0.401 compiles the existing typed rules. Journal Snapshot/Replay helpers reuse its unchanged schema-1 validation. Native controls use a boardSchema-1 envelope; exported economy journals omit those controls. Only owned assemblies/source/config are packaged; engine and runtime remain external.
media: No external art, sound, characters from franchises or SDK/runtime binary redistributed. Vaelis/Madra/Nira/Morrak names come from the seed; venues, rules, policies and feedback are new.
quality_boundary: Actual compilation, native controls/keyboard/OpenGL and outside-source runtime-only project execution, plus implementing-agent visual/gameplay judgment. Scripted inputs are not independent human playtests; no accessibility, other-platform, physical controller, standalone executable, commercial demand or historical restoration claim.
native: Any-seat solo and all nonempty local-seat sets; explicit turn handoff, actor-correct map/objective/previews/results, bounded rival forecasts up to the next human choice, local-seat save/replay and original-format export. No economic rules, historical art, network game or unknown human plans are added.
